balls.text: full outside leg. Skips down the ground and clips to deep midwicket. Mumbai Indians finish on 235 for 9
full outside off. Bumrah looks to swing this over the bowler but the outside edge takes it beyond short third man instead!

fifth catch for Nabi - first time in IPL that someone has taken five! Slower ball, back of the hand, full outside off. Surya swings leg side, and mistimed to the man in the deep. Top innings from SKY, most probably his last before the T20 World Cup gets underway. Applause from the dugout and fans as he walks out with the bat raised high

short ball outside off. Suryakumar reaches out to ramp it over the keeper but can't connect. Surya thinks it should be a wide, the front-on umpire probably thinks so too, but the square umpire doesn't feel so, and is therefore considered a legal ball
Suryakumar is back on strike. Full on off stump, but slower this time. Tries to nudge a paddle sweep fine but can't get bat on ball
taken at long on as Chawla is out for a duck. Full and wide outside off. Chawla goes for a big shot down the ground. Mistimed, and Samad won't drop them on the boundary line
length blal just outside off, and fended back to Umran. An expensive end to his debut IPL season, but what potential in him for next season!

off the helmet! Malik is fast so the fielders are just checking on SKY. Back of a length outside off. Suryakumar goes across to the off side to play a shot, but missed. Hit the back of the head after coming off his arm. Physio is checking on him for the concussion test
backward point! Malik goes around the stumps. Full toss outside off. Suryakumar throws his bat at it, and slices it over the infield for four more!
drilled through the gap between cover and mid off! Full and wide, but he moves to the off side before hammering a well-time drive to the boundary
full outside off. SKY changes his stance, gets some bat to reverse sweep, and hits it just wide of Wriddhiman Saha!
full just outside off. Clears the front leg to loft it over cover. Misses the connection as he is beaten by the pace. 144kph
Malik goes very wide outside off. Probably after he saw Suryakumar change his grip for a reverse. Wide given
around the stumps again. Short ball outside off. Chawla sticks the bat out to poke at it. Misses
back of a length, slower ball. Tries to pull, but off the bat's top half. In the air, but well short of the fielder at deep square leg who was running in
full and wide as Holder goes over the stumps. Suryakumar walks across to the off side and then crunches a six over Holder with such ease!
full toss, on his waist, and comfortably flicked over the square-leg umpire for four. Great use of the wrists over again
full outside off from around stumps. Coulter-Nile swings leg side, poor timing off the bat, and Nabi at deep midwicket takes an easy one
full toss just outside off as Holder comes around the stumps. Toe ends a slog in the air, and Garg at long on drops it!
Kaul finishes with 0/56 Good length outside off. Suryakumar stays in his crease, tiptoes to get tall, and then punches a shot over cover for another boundary to end the over
slower ball. Back of a length just outside off. He's through the cut too early. On the bounce to the keeper
good length outside off. Backs away, makes room, and then offers the full face of the bat to loft a four over mid off
tries to play the reverse sweep but misses. Full just outside off, and he can't connect
gets under the ball! Full on middle, and he clubs an up-and-over four to long off. Fifty for the India and Mumbai batter
leading edge takes it past cover. Full ball outside off and he tried to clip a shot to deep midwicket
Full on middle. Googly. And that's too easy for Suryakumar. Swept comfortably behind square for four
good length outside off. Punched towards cover for one

sliced in the air and cover gets under it. Full outside off, and he goes for a slog sweep over the leg side. But the ball is turning away and Krunal slices it to the off side. Time out with that wicket
good length on off. Googly is punched to long on for a single
full on leg. Down on one knee, slog swept well, and enough in that shot for the ball to go beyond deep square leg!
full on his toes on leg stump. Drilled to long on for a single
full on middle. In his range, and he clears the front leg before drilling a shot over midwicket for four! Strong wrists, top timing...
full and wide outside off stump. Mistimed slog to long on for a single
good length on middle. Continuing around the stumps for Suryakumar. He goes deep and flat-bats a shot to long on
full on off. Shovels an aggresive shot to deep midwicket. Wants two, but Suryakumar falls over while turning for the second
Nabi around the stumps. Full outside off. Krunal drags a sweep square, and Sharma at fine leg runs around the boundary line to parry the ball away. Garg cleans up
full toss on leg stump as Krunal comes charging down. Clipped to deep midwicket for one
full on leg stump. Krunal stays deep in his crease and then slogs one to the leg side. Timed well enough to beat midwicket, and there's nobody in the deep to cut it off
slower ball, full ball. Just outside leg though. Tries to flick square but he's through the shot too early. Hits the pad but not out. No review
full on off stump. Smacks one down the ground but not off the bat's middle
over the fielder at deep backward square! Kaul goes length on off. Ball's angling away and Suryakumar uses his wrists to flick that cross-batted swipe over Holder for six
scooped! Slower ball. Full outside off. Suryakumar runs across to the off side and hits the knuckleball over the keeper's head with some innovative batting

leading edge to cover! Sharma comes over the stumps. Length ball outside off. Neesham backs away to make room. Tries to close the bat's face for a flick. Pops up to Nabi at cover instead. On a hat-trick!

full just outside off. And what amazing field placement! Full just outside off. Pollard goes straight as an arrow down the ground, but Pandey has kept a fielder there for the shot. Roy in front of the sightscreen fumbles and recovers to remove Pollard. Dhoni did that once against Pollard inside the circle. This was on the boundary. Brownie points to the captain!
good length on middle, and angling down the leg side. Saha collects
full outside off. Looks to go across the line to sweep. Misses, hits the front leg, and rolls to the leg side. They pinch a single as the lbw attempt is turned down. Impact outside leg

full on middle, and he drives it straight back. Sharma gets behind the ball and Sharma grabs the ball low. Sharma asks for a caught decision, but the umpire says no. Are they reviewing? No. Bump ball en route to Sharma!
full on middle. He backs away to the leg side. Mistimed to deep midwicket
inside edge past leg stump! Full ball around the stumps. Pollard backs away to hammer a shot through cover but it takes the edge to fine leg
full on middle. Swept, but only to short fine leg
full toss, low on his toes and swept comfortably to deep backward square leg for another boundary!
full on off. Googly flicked to deep midwicket

quick ball on leg and going down the leg side. Suryakumar looks to play the paddle sweep by walking across, misses, hits Saha's pad and the ball rolls away. They take one bye and the umpire says that's not a wide ball since SKY moved leg side
length ball on off. Backs away and strikes down the ground for one
good length on off stump. Rock back to pull but ends up hitting the shot onto his toes
good length outside off. Comes down the ground to nudge it off his waist to deep backward square
full outside off and driven to long off. They jog across for a single
full on off. He walks to the off side and then plays a lovely paddle scoop over the leg side to fine leg for four more!
full on off. Comes forward and defends. Ball rolls down past Kaul, and they pinch a single

Better call Kaul! Full on off and skidding into his pads. Misses the flick, hits the pad, and umpire says out! Pollard has a chat with Suryakumar and then reviews. No bat involved, and Pollard starts walking even before the ball-tracking can be loaded. But hey, hey, hey.... ball tracking says its missing leg stump! Where is Pollard? He's now walking back from just around the boundary line. #Scenes
fullish on off stump, and punched down the ground to long on
good length ball on off, and punched to wide long on for a single
hits the pad but would've gone over. Full ball zipping into leg. Pollard misses the defensive shot, and it hits the flap of the pad
good length on off, and he flicks it to deep fine leg for a single
fullish just outside off. Defended with soft hands to the off side

good length ball on off. Jagging in as he looks to pull with one leg raised. Struck fine, and its going to Holder at fine leg, but it drops in front and zips through him for four. Another error in the field!

Kishan will be disappointed! Malik goes short and wide from around the stumps. Kishan looks to scythe a cut over point, but it's taken an edge into the hands of Wriddhiman Saha. But what a top knock: Kishan has given Mumbai fans hope
full ball on off stump, and he hammers a drive down the ground. Just one though
full on middle, and knocked to wide long on for one
short ball, takes the pace off. Pulls off the back off behind square. Kaul at fine leg runs square to intercept, but he can't stop it! The ball went between his legs

back of a length on middle, and angling down the leg side. Holder goes short since he sees Pollard coming down the track, but the wayward line earns five runs for Mumbai. Saha can't get behind it either
holes out at long on. In the slot, but Hardik can't get the bat through the shot as well as he would've liked. Mistimed, and Roy in the deep gets under it
back of a length, spongy bounce. He looks to pull, but the ball goes over the edge to the keeper
yorker length outside off stump. Digs it away to cover
slower ball. Overpitched, down the leg side. Wide run collected
full outside off. Turning in but not as sharply. He looks to defend and it takes the outside edge to short third man
Hardik goes for it too! Googly turning in, and that's perfect for the batter. Front leg cleared, and the bat swing is smooth. Over cow corner again
full on leg stump. Mistimed slog to long on for a walking single
full on off, and punched down the ground to long on for one
full on middle. Another slog sweep attempted. Mistimed to deep backward square leg
Kishan has hammered Rashid's first ball! A biggie. Full on middle, the googly is turning away, but Kishan takes him on either way. Slog swept to deep midwicket
good length ball on middle, and angling in. Swiped to midwicket to the deep
swung down the ground! Full outside off. Clears the front leg and drills a six over long on. Malik going slow and being punished for it. He's better off aiming for 150kph
good length just outside off but angling in. Flat-batted to long on for a single
good length outside off stump. Bit of a slower ball. Drags a shot over to the leg side for a single
good length, wide outside off. Throws his bat at it, and scythes it over cover! Four more.
full outside off and driven to the right of mid off
good length on leg. Turning across to off. Stays on the back foot and punches to long on. 83/1 after the powerplay
full on off. Googly is driven to long on for a single
good length, on leg stump. Pulled off the back foot to deep square leg

good length, outside off stump. Rohit looks to play a paddle over square leg but the ball takes a top edge. In the air, and Nabi runs back from square leg to take a tough catch. Rashid breaks this blazing partnership
full on middle. Clears the front leg and struck to long on for a single
good length on off, and the googly turns in. Flicked to deep midwicket
up and over! Length ball on off. Kishan moves to the leg side to make room, and then absolutely hammers a four down the ground
good length, angling into him. Swipes across the line and hits it to deep backward square leg
around the stumps. Length ball, wide outside off, and Kishan drags a pull from way beyond off to smack a four through cow corner
short ball, angling in. Hurries onto Rohit who mistimes the pull, a rare thing for him. Lands well short of deep backward square leg
guided! Straying in line. Into his pads, and flicked comfortably to deep backward square leg for four more
good length ball outside off stump, and fended off the back foot to mid off

fastest fifty of IPL 2021! Full toss around off, and he flat-bats in front of square. Goes through the hands of midwicket, but once that happens, it goes for four. 50 in 16 balls, beating the IPL 2021 record that was previously held by Pollard (17 balls)
flat-batted over midwicket for four! Holder going short, and Kishan giving him the reply
short ball, and Kishan goes for another pull. Top-edged over short fine leg for six!
slower ball, short ball on middle. Pulled to Samad at deep midwicket, and Kishan has once again returned for the second run
good length, on off. Angling in, and pulled to short fine leg for one
hooked! But falls just short of Rashid at deep backward square leg. Holder goes short, Rohit goes for the shot, but Rashid might have run in a bit late. Bounces past his body and goes for four
full just outside off. Kishan clears the front leg and drills a four past Rohit to long on for four!
full outside off stump. Presses forward and slaps a shot to wide long off for one
around the stumps. Full on middle, and Kishan gets low before swiping a slog behind square on the leg side. Garg's in the deep, but the ball goes further away from him
full on his toes around leg stump. Clipped to deep midwicket
caressed! Length ball outside off. Rohit rocks back and smothers a punched shot through the off-side gap for another boundary!
good length, on leg, and he flicks through to deep midwicket for a couple more
good length, on middle. Opens the bat's face and guides it down to backward point for four! Small gap between short third man and point, but he pierced it with precision
crunched! Length ball angling across and cut through the small gap on the off side!
back of a length on leg. Stays on the back foot, and flat bats a shot over Kaul's head for another swatted boundary
just wide of mid on! Short ball, pulled in front of square. Holder moves to his left at mid on to take a catch but it goes just past him. Mistimed by Kishan, but takes the four nonetheless
fullish on off and angling across. Smothers a drive to cover
full outside off stump. Swept to square leg, but no run taken
good length outside off stump. Tries to cut, but bottom-edged onto the deck
good length outside off stump. Punched down the ground to the bowler
full on middle, and pushed off the front foot to the left of midwicket
around the stumps. Full on off, and Kishan has teed off first ball! Down on one knee, and slogged over deep midwicket. Kishan would enjoy that angle that the bowler is offering
good length outside off and a bit of swing movement in the air. Cut square, but stopped by Pandey at point with a dive

short on leg stump, and Pandey pulls to the right of deep midwicket to end the league phjase with a hobbled single. Looks like he's cramping, and he collapses in a heap after completing the run. A metaphor for SRH's performance through this tournament?
full outside off, and Pandey uses the room on offer to free his arms and flat-bat it to the right of long-off
shot. Full on middle stump, makes a lot of room and plays a pleasing drive out to sweeper cover
only a single this time. Fullish on off stump, swiped to deep midwicket
very full, close to off stump, and Pandey brings out a bottom-hand shovel down the ground to hit it with great power back past the stumps at the other end
shortish, slanting away from off stump, flat-batted to long-off. Doesn't take the run
back of a length on off stump, lets it come and opens his bat face to guide to deep third
slower length ball outside off, and Kaul makes a feeble attempt at a push into the covers, fails to connect

gone, caught on the juggle. Full-toss close to off stump, and he drives it hard, back towards the bowler, and it smacks Coulter-Nile's left wrist and balloons in the air for a far easier second attempt. But the initial impact has hurt Coulter-Nile's wrist
shortish outside off, chopped to short third
shortish slower ball on off stump. Swings mightily, but far too early, into a pull, and ends up bottom-edging into the pitch
short of a length, slogged to wide long-on after making room
full-toss on off stump, swiped along the ground to deep midwicket
loopy slower ball outside off, jabbed to extra-cover
shortish outside off, and the Bumrah offcutter grips and turns again. Looks to punch into the covers, ends up playing it back to the bowler off the inside half of the bat
back of a length offcutter outside off. Looks to drive through the covers and he's beaten on the inside edge

got him, the slower ball does the trick. It's a slower ball fairly wide of off stump, and Rashid reaches out to try and slash it to deep point, but he's so early on the shot that he ends up almost flicking it back to the bowler off the inside half of the bat
yorker close to off stump, jams down and squeezes it towards backward point
shortish slower ball on off stump, flat-batted to long-on
shortish, swiped to deep midwicket
full on off stump, and that's a clean hit from Rashid. Clears his front leg and drives sweetly over mid-off, with a full follow-through
short and fairly wide, was the slower ball, but with third man and backward point in the circle, he's able to get under the ball and uppercut over the circle
slower short ball outside off, looks to cut it but can't connect
one of them will have to walk back now. Full, angling into leg stump, looks to clear his front leg and hit it down the ground, but he ends up picking out Boult at long-on
shot! Short outside off, and Pandey goes deep in his crease to flat-bat and thread the gap between extra-cover and long-off
length ball outside off, steered past the right hand of the diving backward point fielder, and to the left of deep point, to bring up Pandey's half-century. Excellent innings on his captaincy debut
wide slower ball, not quite a yorker, and once again ending up on the wrong side of the tramline. Pandey can't connect with the slash
wide yorker, just wide of the tramline. Reaches out to stab it away but can't connect
full, slanting into the stumps from wide of the crease, pushed down to long-on
full, angling into the stumps, clears his front leg and lofts it flat, on the bounce, to long-on
loopy slower ball, full and fairly wide of off, opens his bat face to stab to backward point

slower ball, loses his shape, and that's the end of Garg's innings. Looks to step forward and loft it straight, but ends up playing too early, and hitting it straight up, with his bottom hand coming off the handle. Mid-on moves a few steps back and to his left and judges the high catch very well
back of a length on off stump, steps across to tuck it to deep square leg
length ball on off stump, punched to the right of extra-cover
bam. Pandey's turning it on now. It's full, not quite full enough to be yorker length, and he clears his front leg for a bottom-handed whip to beat long-on to his left
shot! Short, angling in towards off stump, and Pandey steps to the leg side as he so often does, and creates room to swing powerfully and pull over the square leg boundary
full, angling in from wide of the crease, uses his wrists to clip it to deep midwicket from outside off
slower short ball on off stump, clears his front leg and swats it to deep midwicket on the bounce
full on middle stump, clears his front leg and drives firmly to long-on
slower length ball angling across to off stump, shuffles out of his crease to deep midwicket
short slower ball angling away from off stump, looks to dab it fine but can't connect
slants a length ball wide of off stump, and he chops it away to deep point
fullish on middle and off, clipped towards deep midwicket
length ball finishing on middle stump, blocked back to the bowler
tossed up wide of off stump, driven with a lot of bottom hand to long-off
back of a length, slides on towards middle stump, punched off the back foot to deep midwicket
back of a length on middle stump, slides on straight, punched to long-off
tossed up on middle and leg, swiped along the floor towards long-on
back of a length close to off stump, punched to sweeper cover
shot. Poor ball from Chawla, short and wide, and Garg rochs back to cut it fiercely to the right of backward point
looks for the wide yorker, doesn't quite get it as full as he'd like, but the line is good, and Pandey, reaching out to stab it away, can't make contact
back of a length on top of off stump, lets it come and dab to the right of short third man
short now, and that's a super shot! It's angling into Garg's body, but he steps back and across to get off-side of the ball and swivel to hook it away over the backward square leg boundary
low full-toss outside off, and there's just enough room for Garg to free his arms and stab that away with an open face to beat the diving sweeper cover to his left
back of a length, just outside off, swatted down to long-on
full slower ball on off stump, and that's a clean hit, clears his front leg and drives flat, on the bounce to beat long-on to his left
wrong'un, pitching outside off, goes back and tucks it into the midwicket region
tossed up outside off, jumps out and lofts it one-bounce to long-off
tossed up outside off, stretches out and lap-sweeps fine
shortish slider on off stump, makes room and chops to deep point
looped up wider and Garg steps out to drive to sweeper cover
legbreak looped up just outside off, gets forward to punch to cover
fullish, close to off stump, driven down to long-on off the inside half of the bat
short slower ball close to off stump, pulled to deep square leg
slower legcutter on a length outside off. Gets forward to push into the covers, ends up inside-edging into his front pad, playing a touch too early
shortish legcutter outside off, gets on his toes and punches to deep point

huuuge appeal as Garg looks to flick and misses an offcutter. Neesham is pleading, but VK Sharma won't budge. Mumbai have no review remaining either. Looks like it was sliding down leg, possibly. Yup, ball-tracking confirms it
holes out. Length ball outside off, and Samad takes on long-on and hits it straight down his throat
back of a length close to off stump, punched with an open face towards sweeper cover to bring up SRH's 100
shortish on off stump, makes room and punches to sweeper cover
back of a length, wrong'un, spinning into the stumps, punched off the back foot to long-on

got him. The big boundaries strike again. Steps out, and Chawla widens his line outside off. Looks to go over long-on, and ends up offering the fielder a catch. Pollard does well to sprint to his left and catch it in front of his chest
drags down a short ball on leg stump, and Pandey pulls it on the bounce to deep square leg
flat length ball on middle and leg, clipped down to long-on
tossed up on off stump, drifts in a touch and doesn't turn, and the attempted cover drive ends up hit back to the bowler off the inside half of the bat
flat length ball on the stumps, clipped to the left of deep square leg
length ball extremely wide of off stump, and Pandey reaches out and flat-bats it over the leaping cover fielder
high full-toss over off stump, quite slow and loopy, and Pandey steps away from leg stump to make hitting room, and swats it dismisively over the midwicket boundary. It's a no-ball too, for height
shortish and very slow outside off, slapped to sweeper cover
steps out and Krunal shortens his length slightly outside off. Whipped down to long-on
full on off stump, clipped to long-on

and the change of angle does the trick. Back of a length, angling into the stumps, and he clears his front leg and takes on the man at deep midwicket. Gets a little too much underneath the ball, and he ends up offering an easy catch to the boundary fielder. This ground has really long square boundaries
short, slanting away from the left-hander and offering plenty of width. Slices his slash a little, to the left of Bumrah at deep third. Wanted to hit it squarer, I think
slower length ball outside off, lets it come and steers to deep point
short slower ball, sits up nicely outside off, and Pandey plays his trademark tennis-style pull to the left of midwicket

slower ball, slanting across to off stump, and Abhishek clears his front leg and skews his big hit squarer than intended, up in the air but landing safely between the converging deep point, extra-cover and wicketkeeper
length ball angling into the pads, clipped to deep square leg
too full, too straight, and that's poor bowling with fine leg in the circle. Abhishek flicks neatly off his toes and beats that fielder to his right
short on leg stump, pulled to fine leg, and that is the end of Mumbai's playoffs hopes
awkward. Short ball comes in off the pitch and follows Pandey as he looks to lean away from the line and maybe ramp it. He's forced to fend at it and he manages to keep it down, back down the pitch
short again, angling into the left-hander's body and getting up to shoulder height. Controls the pull nicely out to deep square leg

bouncer, perfectly directed to imperil the hook. Has to fetch it from over his right shoulder, and he ends up miscuing it down the throat of the fine leg fielder. Mumbai finally have a wicket, with SRH needing just two runs to knock them out
shot! Steps across to the off side, exposes all his stumps, and he shovels Boult's off-stump length ball down to the fine leg boundary, too fine for fine leg to catch up with
back of a length again, this time the slower ball bites into the pitch and slows down, so Abhishek doesn't have as much pace to work with for the late dab. Plays it straight to short third
three in a row. Back of a length in the corridor, and he lets it come and opens his bat face to bisect backward point and short third
four more. Now Coulter-Nile overpitches, while angling in towards off stump, and Abhishek clears his front leg and hits it flat and clean over mid-off

shot! That's a short ball that's angling in from around the wicket and potentially set to cramp him for room. A bit of bounce too, but he slaps it away with both feet in the air, and beats backward point to his left
quick bouncer, getting up around the front shoulder. Cramps him on the hook, and he ends up gloving it along the ground towards short fine leg
steps out and Coulter-Nile shortens the length of his slower offcutter. The ball sneaks under the attempted pull, and zips past leg stump

full on middle and leg, looks to whip it against the angle and miscues it, and Hardik Pandya, turning around and running towards the boundary from mid-on, puts down a tough chance, the ball slipping through his grasp as he looks to reel it in from over his right shoulder
low full-toss on middle stump, punched towards mid-off
short, sits up at waist height on off stump, and Roy opens up at the hip to swat it away to the midwicket boundary. He's dashing Mumbai fans' hopes in a hurry
sharp bouncer, but it's angling down leg, and Roy misses his hook, and Kishan, diving left, can't quite gather it. Hits the edge of his left glove and runs away for five wides
slower ball, ends up as a full-toss close to off stump, loses his bottom-hand grip while punching to mid-off
full on leg stump, clipped to fine leg
back of a length close to off stump, punched away to the right of backward point

shot. Dangled up right into the slot, on off stump or thereabouts, and Abhishek clears his front leg and slogs it away over the midwicket boundary. Wrong'un, but it was full enough to make hitting against the spin a non-issue
floated up on leg stump, swiped along the floor to long-on
wrong'un, dips onto a nice length, looks to sweep and misses but the impact is probably outside off stump
tossed up on off stump, and Roy clears his front leg for a heave that finds the gap between square leg and short fine leg
wrong'un, but it's short and it's wide, and Roy just stands where he is and slaps it away between extra-cover and mid-off. Poor delivery
tossed up on leg stump, driven to long-on
slower ball, back of a length outside off. Looks to punch through mid-off with no footwork, and the offcutter spins past his inside edge

bam! Terrific shot from Roy. Jumps out of his crease, gets fairly close to the pitch of this off-stump length ball while sashaying towards the leg side to make room to free his arms, and flat-bats it back over the bowler's head
bouncer, climbing quickly over off stump. Drops his right shoulder and lets it pass
shot. Pitches short outside off, and Roy stands tall and pulls, meeting it on top of the bounce and hitting it well wide of mid-on. No midwicket in place, thanks to the two slips
length ball slanting across to off stump, clipped to the right of midwicket
length ball angling in towards off stump, stays on the back foot and clips to fine leg
looks for swing, and pitches a touch too full outside off. Doesn't quite time this lofted drive, but manages to clear mid-off and land the ball well beyond the fielder

big appeal for lbw as Abhishek misses the across-the-line flick. It straightened, but did it pitch in line? Not given, and Mumbai have reviewed... Seemed to pitch in line with leg stump or thereabouts. Did it straighten enough, or was it sliding down leg? No inside edge. Pitches in line, but it didn't straighten enough. Umpire's call on impact, and the ball is missing leg stump comfortably
back of a length, swinging in towards off stump, defends and the ball rolls off the inside half of the bat to fine leg
length ball on off stump, and Roy steps across to whip it over midwicket. Doesn't middle it at all, but he manages to clear the fielder fairly comfortably
full, swinging back into the stumps, clipped to mid-on
full, slanting away from off stump. Roy looks to crash it through the covers, and fails to connect
